PLAN "12-Week Strength & Hypertrophy Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build maximal strength on compound lifts"
  GOAL secondary hypertrophy:
    name "Improve body composition and lean mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1x10
          bodyweight squat 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
          push_up 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          inverted_row 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Saturday training 60m "Full Body Accessory":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          hip_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
